verdict.rationale: Baseten Model APIs explicitly support the OpenAI Chat Completions API (and Anthropic Messages API), enabling agents to switch providers by just changing base_url without provider-specific code, and Baseten Switch further supports routing requests between Baseten and OpenAI/Anthropic mid-workflow. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of seamless mid-workflow switching beyond docs, and no explicit evidence of full parity across all OpenAI Chat Completions parameters/edge cases.
